# Zero-Shot Learning Through Cross-Modal Transfer

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Richard Socher, Milind Ganjoo, Christopher D. Manning, Andrew Y. Ng  
**Year:** 2013  
**Journal:** NeurIPS  
**DOI:** [10.48550/arXiv.1301.3666](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.1301.3666)  
**Publisher:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/1301.3666](https://arxiv.org/abs/1301.3666)

**Keywords:** zero-shot, transfer

## Abstract

We introduce a model that can recognize objects in images even if no training data is available for the class.
